jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Company:
Oliver Wyman

Description:

Senior Product Manager

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our team at Marsh. This role will be based in Mexico City. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. As the Senior Product Manager, you will apply Agile principles and frameworks to enable iterative delivery, effective prioritization, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement throughout the product and initiative lifecycle. As an internal role, the Tech Product Manager supports initiatives and teams across Oliver Wyman. While our primary focus is on consulting, this position is situated within our Technology organization.

We will count on you to :

- Drive and execute Oliver Wyman Tech initiatives aligned with firm and departmental strategy.
- Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships, manage expectations, and ensure roles, responsibilities, and priorities are clearly defined.
- Partner with stakeholders and technology teams to support annual budgeting and forecasting processes.
- Develop initiative plans with clear objectives, deliverables, milestones, communication plans, and success measures.
- Apply Agile frameworks and ways of working to structure delivery, manage priorities, and enable incremental value delivery.
- Lead product delivery in fast-paced, cross-functional environments using Scrum, Kanban, or similar frameworks to manage dependencies and drive measurable outcomes.
- Facilitate Agile ceremonies and working sessions, including planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives, to maintain alignment and delivery momentum.
- Partner with Product Owners, technology teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize requirements, manage backlogs, and translate needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, and iterative enhancements.
- Identify critical paths, dependencies, and risks; track them and facilitate appropriate mitigation.
- Manage initiative resources and budgets to ensure objectives and financial targets are met.
- Report initiative health and status using agreed initiative management systems and tools.
- Promote continuous improvement by leveraging feedback, delivery insights, and lessons learned to strengthen team effectiveness and outcomes.
- Ensure initiative closure meetings are held and produce closure reports highlighting outcomes, lessons learned, and areas for improvement.

What you need to have :

- 6 + years of experience working as Product Manager or equivalent experience.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or equivalent experience.
- Strong interpersonal skills, including teamwork, facilitation, negotiation, and consensus building, complemented by excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
- In-depth knowledge and practical application of Agile methodologies and frameworks, including Scrum, as well as traditional initiative management approaches, with the ability to adapt delivery methods based on the needs of the product, initiative, and organization.
- A solid technical background with experience in product ownership and relationship management, particularly in managing cloud implementation initiatives within large organizations (AWS primary or Azure, GCP).
- Proficient in budgeting, invoicing, and initiative financial management, supported by excellent analytical and technical skills.
- Highly organized with exceptional planning capabilities, a strong customer service orientation, and a polished, professional demeanor.
- Proven ability to plan and facilitate effective meetings, deliver strong presentations, and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, with over five years of experience in product and initiative management.

What makes you stand out :

- Proven ability to oversee the complete product lifecycle, from ideation and development through launch and post-launch analysis, ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.
- Ability to translate strategic objectives and stakeholder needs into clear product priorities, roadmaps, backlogs, and measurable outcomes, using Agile practices to continuously refine priorities and deliver business value.

Why join our team :

- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
- We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
- Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

What can you expect?
Marsh’s Placement Portfolio is undergoing a technical transformation in order make Marsh the Risk Advisor of the Future – a digitally enabled, insights-led, client-centric and data and AI driven organization. That’s why we’re transforming the way we work by improving our efficiency and developing new solutions to deliver an exceptional digital-first experience for the company and its clients.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to support delivery, with annual spend of up to $5 million or revenue support of approximately $200 million. This senior manager role reports to the Marsh Tech Portfolio Delivery Lead.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across teams, building strong relationships, and helping ideas become reality. Communication skills are highly important. Ability to communicate across all team members is essential for project success. The TPM needs to work with the business to understand their vision and work across the development teams to bring the vision to reality.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to make a meaningful impact, collaborate across the business, and contribute to the delivery of valuable products and services. This is a leadership role within the Marsh Tech and is based in the Marsh Innovation Centre in Dublin.

We will count on you to:
- Partner with business leaders, product owners, engineers, architects and delivery leads to shape and maintain multi-year product roadmaps.
- Coordinate IT delivery in partnership with Product and Delivery Engineering Leads.
- Support delivery, helping ensure new capabilities are delivered on time, within budget, follow Marsh architecture and engineering standards and use AI tooling where possible.
- Manage product runtime and capital resources and budgets.
- Own and maintain the data in Marsh Technology Asset Inventories, ensuring it remains accurate, up to date, and regularly reviewed.
- Proactively identify emerging technologies within the market and across the wider Marsh enterprise that could help address business needs in your area.

What you must to have:
- Proven experience delivering technology initiatives successfully.
- Strong communication skills are highly important. Ability to communicate across all team members is essential for project success.
- Experience operating at a senior manager level and working in partnership with senior business leaders to define strategies and product roadmaps.
- Strong stakeholder management and business engagement skills.
- A strong, broad understanding of technology and how it can be used to solve business challenges.
- Experience in technology strategy, roadmap planning, and project budgeting.
- The ability to build strong relationships at all levels of the organisation.
- A good understanding and practical experience working in Agile development.
- Experience managing the technology strategy for one or more products.
- Relevant technical qualifications such as SAFe SPC or ASPC and/or SAFe Lean Portfolio Management would be beneficial.

What makes you stand out:
- Your problem solving and critical thinking skills: you can simplify complexity, and work with product and engineering to deliver solutions that work for the business.
- Your experience with large scale, complex, business critical globally deployed solutions.
- Great communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable working in a distributed environment, with an ability to form good working relationships across teams, locations, and time zones.
- A solid understanding of the Insurance business area supported by your product portfolio, including relevant external market trends.
- A solid understanding of the Insurance or Broker business would be beneficial.

Why join our team:
- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
- We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
- Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities.

Note this role is based in the MMC Innovation Centre in Dublin, and the successful candidate is expected to be in the office 3 days per week.
Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other less represented groups tend to only apply when they check every box. So, if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on what is needed, please still get in touch.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, IT
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh McLennan Agency

Description:

Our not-so-secret sauce.

Award-winning, inclusive, Top Workplace culture doesn’t happen overnight. It’s a result of hard work by extraordinary people. The industry’s brightest talent drive our efforts to deliver purposeful work and meaningful impact every day. Learn more about what makes us different and how you can make your mark as a Senior Product Manager, IT at MMA.

Marsh McLennan Agency (MMA) provides business insurance, employee health & benefits, retirement, and private client insurance solutions to organizations and individuals seeking limitless possibilities. With offices across North America, we combine the personalized service model of a local consultant with the global resources of the world’s leading professional services firm, Marsh McLennan (NYSE: MMC).

A day in the life.

The Senior Product Manager, IT drives the strategy, roadmap and delivery of core IT products and platforms that enable business processes, operational excellence, and security across the organization. This role partners closely with stakeholders across IT and the business to define value-driven product initiatives, prioritize work, and ensure successful implementation and adoption. The Senior Product Manager combines technical fluency, customer-focused product thinking, and strong delivery leadership to maximize product outcomes and measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

- Define and own product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for assigned IT platforms (e.g., identity & access management, digital workplace, enterprise integrations, data platforms, security tooling, cloud platform services).

- Translate business needs and technical constraints into clear product requirements, user stories and prioritized backlogs.

- Lead product planning and prioritization using data, stakeholder inputs and business value to ensure alignment with organizational goals.

- Partner with engineering, architecture, security, operations, vendor partners and business SMEs to deliver high-quality releases on time and on budget.

- Act as product owner in Agile delivery teams: clarify scope, accept deliverables, manage sprint priorities and remove blockers.

- Drive product adoption and change management through stakeholder engagement, communications, training plans and measurement.

- Define and monitor product success metrics (KPIs), use analytics to inform decisions, and report product performance to leadership.

- Manage vendor relationships and third-party product lifecycle where applicable, including requirements, RFPs, contract alignment and performance reviews.

- Ensure product designs meet security, compliance, privacy and accessibility standards and contribute to risk mitigation activities.

- Mentor and coach junior product managers and contribute to product management best practices and governance across IT.

Our future colleague.

We’d love to meet you if your professional track record includes these skills:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Systems, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).

- 5+ years of product management experience in IT or technology environments, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise IT products or platforms.

- Proven track record delivering complex, multi-stakeholder IT initiatives from discovery through production.

- Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, Agile methodologies and modern cloud-native architectures .

- Experience working with technical teams (engineering, architecture, security) and translating technical concepts for business stakeholders.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.

- Data-driven decision-making skills; experience defining and tracking KPIs and using analytics to inform prioritization.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Advanced degree (MBA, MS) or relevant certifications (CSPO, PMP, Pragmatic Institute, SAFe /Product Owner).

- Experience with identity/access management, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), integration platforms, ITSM, or enterprise data platforms.

- Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO27001, GDPR).

- Prior experience in a regulated industry or large global organization.

Skills & Competencies:

- Strategic thinking with strong business acumen and customer-centric mindset.

- Technical literacy and ability to engage in architectural and engineering discussions.

- Strong prioritization, organization and time-management capabilities.

- Negotiation and vendor management skills.

- Ability to influence without direct authority and build consensus across diverse stakeholders.

- Problem-solving orientation and comfort with ambiguity.

- Empathy for end users and focus on delivering measurable value.

We know there are excellent candidates who might not check all of these boxes. Don’t be shy. If you’re close, we’d be very interested in meeting you.

Valuable benefits.

We value and respect the impact our colleagues make every day both inside and outside of work. Our culture promotes colleague well-being through robust benefits programs and resources, professional and personal development opportunities, and fulfillment through meaningful work.

Some benefits included in this role are:

- Generous time off, including personal and volunteering

- Tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities

- Remote work

- Charitable contribution match programs

- Stock purchase opportunities

To learn more about a career at MMA, check us out our website or flip through recruiting brochure .

Follow us on social media to meet our colleagues and see what makes us tick:

- Instagram

- Facebook

- X

- LinkedIn

Who you are is who we are.

We embrace a culture that celebrates and promotes the many backgrounds, heritages and perspectives of our colleagues and clients. We are always seeking those with ethics, talent, and ambition who are interested in joining our client-focused teams.

Marsh McLennan and its affiliates are EOE Minority/Female/Disability/Vet/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity employers.

#LI-REMOTE

The applicable base salary range for this role is $94,500 to $165,300.

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition assistance, 401K savings and other retirement programs as well as employee assistance programs.

Applications will be accepted until:

October 16, 2026

jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh Risk

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Senior Operational Technical Product Manager team at Marsh. This role will be based in Kuala Lumpur. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

Based in Kuala Lumpur, a Senior Operational Technical Product Manager leads a high-performing product team and is accountable for both delivery outcomes and the ongoing health of assigned applications. You translate business priorities into a clear, actionable backlog and release plan, partnering with stakeholders to define scope, success measures, and trade-offs. Working closely with architecture, security and operations, you ensure solutions are secure, resilient and compliant—covering incident/problem management, change and release governance, observability, and continuous improvement. You coach engineers, drive disciplined execution across the SDLC, and provide transparent updates on progress, risks, dependencies, and budget.

We will count on you to:
- Lead and coach a multi-location product team delivering enhancements and operational support across multiple applications.
- Own end-to-end delivery: scope, planning, sprint execution, quality gates, release readiness, and post-release support.
- Drive operational excellence for assigned applications, including incident/problem management, root-cause analysis, and stability improvements.
- Partner with business stakeholders and Marsh Tech colleagues across APAC, including Japan, to align priorities, manage dependencies, and run effective governance.

Technical Ownership

- Lead and coach a high-performing technical team
- Allocate work activities based on business priorities, individual skill sets and workload

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience
- 10+ years’ experience in solution development, design, and technical delivery
- Strong technical leadership and people management skills
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with keen attention to detail
- Proficiency in multiple programming languages and modern development frameworks
- Solid understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid development methodologies
- Knowledge of security, privacy, and regulatory compliance frameworks
- Experience with technology strategy, roadmap planning, and IT budgeting/cost management

What makes you stand out:
- Strategic thinking: Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions
- Technical excellence: Deep technical knowledge combined with the ability to define technology strategies and product roadmaps
- Communication skills: Clear, articulate communication across technical and non-technical audiences; ability to present complex concepts to senior business leaders.

Marsh Health & Benefits (formerly Mercer Marsh Benefits) is a world leader in workplace health and benefits. We provide broking, consulting and technology support to build the right benefits strategy for businesses and employees, from large multinational firms down to SMEs.

We are seeking a Technical Product Director to support the Marsh Health & Benefits (MHB) Technology Portfolio . You will partner with business product owners to define the strategic vision and roadmap for the portfolio.
You will work closely with senior business users and stakeholders (including C‑Suite roles in the MHB business), and global technology teams to ensure the successful delivery of innovative and efficient solutions.

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Finance, Business Administration) or equivalent industry experience / expertise.

- Proven ability to lead complex delivery across both vendor and in-house built technology solutions.

jobs.title: Head of Product (Darwin)
jobs.description:
Company:
Mercer

Description:

As the Head of Product, you will report to the Product and Proposition Leader  accountable for the product roadmap and delivery outcomes across Darwin’s portfolio of solutions, ensuring our products are client-centric, commercially sound, and feasible within Darwin Services and Technology strategy and capability. You will lead a high-performing Product team of 10 FTE, and you will work closely with peers across the Darwin Commercial, Technology and Service Delivery teams as well as the wider Marsh organisation.

This is a senior, multi-faceted role in a large and complex organisation, requiring excellent judgement, structured prioritisation, and the ability to lead through influence as well as line management. The roll will also importantly involve client facing meetings and presentations so require ability to be a vocal advocate for the product. You will balance strategic direction with hands-on leadership of delivery, ensuring product decisions translate into measurable outcomes for clients and the business.

We will count on you to:
- Define and own Darwin’s multi-year roadmap, aligning to business goals, market needs, and Darwin’s delivery capabilities.
- Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary product organisation of 10 FTE, creating clarity of purpose, strong ways of working, and high performance across Product Management and UX (supported by the Head of UX).
- Partner with Sales, Client Management, Technology and Services leadership to shape sequencing priorities and investment decisions, ensuring plans are realistic, resilient and deliverable.
- Work with sales and client management to deliver a cohesive message to clients building positive belief in the existing capabilities and future direction of the Darwin Product.
- Champion the use of AI (including Agentic AI) to improve client outcomes and internal delivery efficiency across the Darwin product portfolio.
- Define and prioritise an AI/automation roadmap, identifying where agentic workflows can safely augment user journeys and operational processes (with appropriate human-in-the-loop controls).
- Partner with Technology, Data, Security, Risk and Legal to ensure Responsible AI governance (privacy, security, model risk, auditability, and regulatory compliance) is embedded from discovery through to live service.
- Establish clear success metrics and quality gates for AI features (evaluation approaches, experimentation/A-B testing, monitoring, incident response and continuous improvement).
- Build AI capability within Product (ways of working, tooling, training and change adoption), and shape build/buy/partner decisions for AI platforms and vendors.
- Engage directly with clients, in partnership with commercial teams, on an ad hoc basis to communicate product strategy and roadmap as well as listen to feedback and requirements.
- Drive a client-centric experience across the product portfolio, ensuring UX and product design quality are embedded from concept through to delivery and continuous improvement.
- Oversee the commercial success of the product portfolio, working with Commercial, Sales and Client Management teams to support positioning, packaging, pricing inputs (where relevant), enablement and go-to-market execution.
- Create clear product narratives and stakeholder communications, including updates for senior leadership, and ensuring teams across Darwin and Mercer understand “what’s changing and why”.
- Put in place effective governance, reporting and performance management (OKRs/KPIs), using insight to drive continuous improvement in outcomes, throughput and quality.
- Drive continuous improvement in ways of working within your team and across the business.
- Build strong relationships across Mercer to connect product direction with broader strategic initiatives, operational needs, risk/compliance considerations, and client commitments.

What you need to have:
- Significant experience leading product teams and delivering outcomes across complex, multi-stakeholder organisations, with demonstrable people leadership at scale.
- You bring a strong SaaS or software product background, ideally in a business that serves enterprise clients and operates at scale.
- Proven track record of owning product strategy and translating it into prioritised roadmaps, measurable outcomes and successful launches.
- Direct experience engaging with prospects and clients to support the broader business agenda.
- Strong experience of end-to-end product lifecycle management: discovery, market/problem analysis, business casing, delivery and early life optimisation.
- Experience embedding user-centred design, research and service design practices into product development.
- Strong commercial acumen, with experience working with Sales/Commercial/Client Management teams on go-to-market planning, client messaging and enablement.
- Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to craft and present clear, compelling narratives to senior leaders and cross-functional audiences.
- Experience operating in an environment with technology and operational constraints, able to balance strategic ambition with pragmatic delivery sequencing.
- Strong analytical mindset and comfort with data-informed prioritisation, benefits tracking, and performance reporting.
- A friendly, open-minded and collaborative leadership style, comfortable navigating ambiguity, changing priorities and complex problem spaces.
- AI experience, including designing and delivering AI-enabled user experiences (e.g., GenAI/agentic workflows and automation) with appropriate Responsible AI controls and human-in-the-loop governance.

What makes you stand out?
- You have led product teams in large, complex, matrixed organisations, and you know how to influence across multiple stakeholders to get the right outcomes.
- You have a proven ability to turn strategy into delivery, translating business goals, market insight, and client needs into clear roadmaps and measurable results.
- You are confident operating with commercial, technology, service delivery, and client teams, and can align different priorities without losing momentum.
- You have experience leading multi-disciplinary teams, including Product and UX, and know how to create clarity, accountability, and high performance.
- You have experience working with or within benefits, HR, employee experience, or similar client-facing platform environments.
- You are a clear communicator and trusted leader who can simplify complexity and help teams and senior leaders understand what is changing and why.

Why join our team:
- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
- We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients
- and communities.
- Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being

jobs.title: Product Owner - Cyber Digital & Data (contract)
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

What can you expect?
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Cyber Risk team at Marsh Ireland. This role will be based in Dublin. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

As a Cyber Digital & Data’s Product Owner, you will play a critical role to help successfully deliver Marsh’s most significant, large scale, complex programs aligned to our global Cyber strategic transformation and change agenda. You will be the connecting point between technology, business and leadership.

Managing Cyber digital products and services end-to-end to achieve business outcomes. Contributing to a detailed and robust Cyber’s Digital and Data’s product roadmap. Participating in product discovery exercises focused on crystallizing the end-user need and curating demand for Cyber digital product domain.

This role will be an initial 6 month fixed term contract with the view to permanency.

We will count on you to:
- Roadmap Development: Lead and shape Cyber’s digital and data solutions product roadmap, ensuring alignment with Cyber practice needs and strategic objectives.

- Requirement Analysis:  Develop a deep understanding of Cyber digital and data business objectives and customer/end-user requirements, translating them into actionable backlogs for delivery teams.

- Product Prioritization: Ensure digital and data solution’s prioritization is strategically aligned and define Cyber’s Digital Solutions Product KPIs, aligned with business KPIs, to monitor performance and success of Cyber Practice Growth.

- Communication: Collaborate with leaders across Marsh / MMC, external partners, and clients to understand and document requirements for digital solutions. Proactively communicate risks, dependencies, and changes to Product roadmap to stakeholders, sponsors, and users.

- Alignment & Planning: Ensure vision and goals of new product development are consistently articulated and establish delivery schedules with engineering teams to ensure timely product releases.

- Collaboration: Undertake regular work stream meetings, documenting and following up on actions and risks identifies from the meetings and escalate where needed, while ensuring remediation action plans are implemented

- Emerging Technologies: Monitor Cyber industry trends, cybersecurity developments, regulatory changes, and competitor actions to anticipate their impact on the Cyber practice and inform strategic planning.

What you need to have:
- Experience: 6 or more years hands-on experience in a lead product development or product management role. Experience in or knowledge of Insurance, Broking and/or Carrier markets is beneficial.

- Hands-On Approach: Hands-on experience in partnering with engineering teams on agile product delivery and documenting requirements (e.g., user stories).

- Problem-Solving: A creative problem solver who can address challenges, adapt to changing circumstances, and make strategic adjustments to optimize product outcomes.

- Process Improvements: Demonstrable experience in developing and executing new product development/product prioritization frameworks and processes.

- Data & Analytics: Advanced analytical and quantitative reasoning capabilities, leveraging customer, market, and commercial data to inform product strategies. A technical background in business analysis, engineering, data, or data science is beneficial.

- Communication: Clear, persuasive communication skills, able to shape alignment and influence decisions across product, technology, and customer facing teams. Demonstrated ability to communicate with managers, stakeholders, and delivery-partners

- Goal Focus:  Delivery and goal focus with a drive to produce products that have a meaningful impact on customers and the business.

What makes you stand out?
- Background in software engineering, QA, or systems analysis.

- Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Postman, or Figma.

- Exposure to SaaS platforms or cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure).

- SAFe® or Comparable Certification a Plus (relevant course topics include but not limited to Agile Product Manager, Lean Portfolio Manager, Product Owner / Product Manager, Agilist)

- Experience with software delivery toolset such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.

Why join our team:
- We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

- We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.

- Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, is a management consulting firm driven by deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.

Job Overview:

Quotient Inside is seeking a Principal Researcher to play a leading role within the Product Strategy team, bringing deep, evidence-based understanding of end users and human behavior to shape firm-wide product, capability, and AI strategy.

This role leads complex research efforts end-to-end and translates findings into clear, actionable insights that inform product direction, strategic priorities, and leadership decisions. The Principal Researcher serves as a trusted thought partner to cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring decisions are grounded in rigorous research, strong end-user empathy, and practical recommendations that drive meaningful action.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead market, qualitative, and quantitative research to inform product and capability strategy

- Design and execute surveys, interviews, diary studies, desk research, and behavioral research

- Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into clear, decision-ready insights and recommendations

- Develop personas, archetypes, and behavioral frameworks grounded in real user contexts

- Contribute directly and shape strategy decks and leadership materials with evidence-based insights

- Translate research findings into implications for product direction, concepts, initiatives, and prioritization

- Maintain deep end-user focus, consistently stepping into the shoes of consultants and practitioners

- Partner proactively with Product Strategy, Design, and Product teams to embed insight early and influence decision-making

Experience Required:
- 8+ years of experience in user research, consumer insights, human-centered research, or behavioral research

- Proven ability to independently lead complex qualitative and quantitative research from design through synthesis and recommendation

- Demonstrated experience using surveys, diary studies, interviews, synthesis, and behavioral analysis to generate actionable insights

- Experience developing personas, archetypes, and behavioral frameworks that inform product, capability, or strategic decisions

- Experience translating research into clear implications, recommendations, and materials for senior stakeholders

- Experience working in or with a consulting organization preferred, with a strong understanding of how consultants and consulting partners work, make decisions, and balance competing client, team, and business priorities

Technical Skills:
- Advanced qualitative research leadership, execution, and synthesis across complex problem statements

- Survey design and applied quantitative analysis to support decision-making

- Strong research documentation, insight synthesis, and clear, compelling storytelling

- Proficiency with research and collaboration tools, including survey platforms, Miro/Mural, and presentation tools

Skills and Attributes:
- Deeply end-user focused, with strong empathy, curiosity, and judgment in understanding human behavior

- Highly analytical and structured thinker, able to bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems

- Clear and compelling communicator, comfortable shaping executive-level narratives, materials, and discussions

- Independent and proactive, able to lead research activities end-to-end and drive action from insights

- Collaborative working style, with the ability to build strong partnerships across strategy, design, and product teams

- Demonstrated ability to work effectively across team-oriented, matrixed environments, building strong relationships and navigating complexity with a wide range of stakeholders

jobs.title: DCX Product Analytics Specialist / Senior Analytics Specialist
jobs.description:
Company:
Marsh

Description:

We are seeking a talented individual to join our Analytics Solutions team, part of Digital Client Experience at Marsh Risk. This role will be based in Zurich or London.

DCX Product Analytics Specialist / Senior Analytics Specialist

We will count on you to:
- Partner with brokers, client executives, product teams, and analytics colleagues to identify risk and renewal pain points and translate them into clear analytical problems and success criteria.
- Prepare, clean, and enrich data from multiple sources including exposure, policies, claims, pricing, engineering, and third-party hazard or vendor model data.
- Build, assess, and validate analytical models and loss modeling approaches to support Property Risk Quantification, including catastrophe and non-catastrophe use cases, with potential application across other lines of business.
- Apply pricing, actuarial, and risk-based techniques to generate actionable insights for loss modeling, portfolio assessment, and business decision-making.
- Prototype dashboards, reports, and analytical outputs that translate technical model results into clear, decision-ready guidance for business stakeholders.
- Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to operationalize analytical workflows, improve data foundations, and support scalable analytics solutions.
- Document models, assumptions, methodologies, and data lineage in line with governance requirements and support transparent interpretation of model outputs.
- Operate effectively in a fast-changing, incubation-style environment where priorities, use cases, and project scope may evolve, helping bring structure and momentum to emerging analytics problems.

What you need to have:
- Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in analytics, actuarial work, catastrophe modeling, pricing, or insurance risk analysis.
- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, Data Science , or equivalent practical experience.
- Solid understanding of statistical modeling, loss modeling, and model validation , ideally in insurance, pricing, or actuarial contexts.
- Experience with catastrophe modeling , Property risk analytics , or related risk quantification approaches, including interpretation and use of model outputs.
- Experience working with insurance-related data and tools, with familiarity with platforms such as RMS, AIR/Verisk , or similar analytics and modeling environments considered a plus.
- Proficiency in Python and/or SQL for analytics, modeling, and data preparation, with experience in reproducible analytical workflows.
- Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau , or similar tools to create prototype dashboards and business-ready analytical outputs.

What makes you stand out:
- Master’s degree in a quantitative field or progress toward an actuarial qualification.
- Experience working in insurance, reinsurance, broking, or risk advisory , particularly in Property cat and non-cat analytics.
- Demonstrated ability to translate technical results into actionable business insights and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
- Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-changing, and not fully structured environments , with the ability to create clarity and move work forward.
- Product mindset with the ability to shape approaches, refine problem statements, and adapt as priorities evolve in an incubation-style setting.
